item.title: How Many Pavers Do I Need? Pavers per 100 Sq Ft Chart
item.description: Planning a DIY paver patio or walkway? See how many pavers you need per 100 square feet for 4x8, 6x6, 12x12, 16x16 and other sizes, plus a free paver calculator with waste allowance.

item.title: How Much Base Gravel and Sand for a Paver Patio? Size Chart
item.description: How much gravel base and bedding sand does a paver patio need? See amounts for patios from 10x10 to 16x20 ft with a 6 inch base and 1 inch of sand, then use the free paver base calculator for your own depths.
